justify_why_units_are_missing.justification: Panel A contains multiple flow-cytometry scatter/histogram axes (e.g., FSC-A, FSC-H, SSC-A, Viability, CD19, IgD) that show signal/channel or light-scatter values; no units (e.g., arbitrary fluorescence units, channel numbers, or FSC/SSC units) are shown on the axis labels or tick labels.
Same as x-axis: axes represent fluorescence intensity or scatter (e.g., SSC-A, FSC-H, CD4, Fas, IgM) but no measurement units are indicated on the plots or in the provided caption.
Panel B shows flow-cytometry dot plots (e.g., CD19, CD98, IgD, FSC-A) where axes are marker names or scatter parameters without any units indicated on the axis labels or in the caption.
As above: y-axes correspond to fluorescence intensity or scatter (e.g., CD98, FSC-A) but no units (such as arbitrary units or channel numbers) are provided on the figure or in the caption.
Panel C contains flow-cytometry plots for NP binding and B-cell markers (e.g., IgD, NP, CD138) labeled by marker names; no explicit measurement units are shown on the axes or defined in the caption.
Y-axes represent fluorescence or marker expression (e.g., IgM, Fas, CD38) but no units (arbitrary fluorescence units or channel numbers) are indicated on the plots or in the caption.

Panel D shows scatter plots of marker expression (e.g., CD44 on x-axis, PD-L2 on x-axes in other plots) and uses marker names with log-scale tick marks but does not label any measurement units (e.g., arbitrary fluorescence units).
Y-axes (e.g., CD62L, CD80) are marker fluorescence intensities with no units specified on the axes or in the caption.

Panel E contains flow-cytometry dot plots (e.g., CD44 on x-axis, PD-L2 on x-axis in other plot) showing marker expression percentages in gated regions but the axes themselves lack measurement units (no arbitrary units or channel labels).
Y-axes (e.g., CD62L, CD80) are labeled by marker name indicating intensity but provide no explicit units on the figure or in the caption.
